title: TrainBridge: Agentic NPU Training Optimization Guided by GPU Compilation Evidence
abstract: arXiv:2610.29171v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study how to improve training efficiency on Ascend NPUs. In the NPU training programs we study, framework-level compilation optimizations such as operator fusion are only partially applied, leaving fragmented computation and avoidable execution overheads. Profiling-guided tuning can address these inefficiencies, but it often requires costly trial and error. To make training on NPUs more efficient, we propose TrainBridge, an agentic approach for transferring GPU optimization guidance to NPU training. TrainBridge uses the highly optimized execution produced by mature GPU compilation stacks as a task-specific reference for NPU tuning. It extracts optimization intents from the GPU training execution to guide NPU program rewrites and further refines the rewritten program through iterative profiling. translated_title: TrainBridge：由GPU编译证据引导的智能体化NPU训练优化
translated_abstract: 我们研究如何提升昇腾（Ascend）NPU上的训练效率。在我们所研究的NPU训练程序中，算子融合等框架级编译优化仅被部分应用，导致计算碎片化和可避免的执行开销。基于性能剖析引导的调优虽然可以解决这些低效问题，但往往需要代价高昂的反复试错。为了让NPU上的训练更加高效，我们提出了TrainBridge，这是一种将GPU优化经验迁移到NPU训练的智能体化方法。TrainBridge利用成熟GPU编译栈生成的高度优化的执行结果，作为NPU调优的任务特定参考。它从GPU训练执行中提取优化意图，用以指导NPU程序重写，并通过迭代式性能剖析进一步优化重写后的程序。我们的GPU到NPU迁移实验表明，TrainBridge在涵盖LLM预训练、图……的四个工作负载上平均实现1.7倍加速。
tldr: TrainBridge提出一种智能体化方法，以成熟GPU编译栈的优化执行为参考，从中提取优化意图指导NPU程序重写并结合迭代式性能剖析进行精调，在四个工作负载上平均实现1.7倍的NPU训练加速。
en_tdlr: TrainBridge is an agentic approach that uses highly optimized GPU compilation execution as a task-specific reference, extracting optimization intents to guide NPU program rewrites and iterative profiling-based refinement, achieving an average 1.7x speedup across four NPU training workloads.
